grammar.pattern: 并且 / 不光 / 不仅 / 另外 / 要是 / 因此 / 由于 / 只有
grammar.purpose: Connect clauses according to their relationship
grammar.explanation: 并且 adds a connected statement; 不光/不仅 introduce the first part of an additive pair with 还/也/而且. 另外 adds a separate point. 要是 introduces an if-condition, commonly answered by 就. 由于 introduces the cause clause and 因此 the consequence; here 由于……，因此…… links two clauses, contrasting the earlier preposition plus cause phrase. 只有 names a necessary condition with 才. Do not interchange cause, addition and condition just because all link statements.

examples.zh: 先确认地点，并且问清费用；另外，还要问人数。
examples.py: xiān què rèn dì diǎn , bìng qiě wèn qīng fèi yòng ; lìng wài , hái yào wèn rén shù .
examples.en: Confirm the venue and expenses; additionally ask the number of people.

examples.zh: 不光要问时间，还要问地点；不仅要公布，也要解释清楚。
examples.py: bù guāng yào wèn shí jiān , hái yào wèn dì diǎn ; bù jǐn yào gōng bù , yě yào jiě shì qīng chǔ .
examples.en: Ask not only the time but the venue; not only announce it but explain clearly.

examples.zh: 要是下雨，就换室内；由于场地没批准，因此先不公布。
examples.py: yào shì xià yǔ , jiù huàn shì nèi ; yóu yú chǎng dì méi pī zhǔn , yīn cǐ xiān bù gōng bù .
examples.en: If it rains, move indoors; because the venue is unapproved, do not announce yet.

examples.py: zhǐ yǒu dà jiā tóng yì , cái gōng bù .

commonMistakes.wrong: 要是大家同意，因此大家同意。
commonMistakes.right: 要是大家同意，就再确认场地。
commonMistakes.why: An if-condition does not assert its own fulfillment; give the corresponding next action.

grammar.purpose: Name a necessary, not sufficient, condition
grammar.explanation: 只有大家同意才公布 sets agreement as necessary for announcing. It does not say agreement alone makes a venue available or forces an announcement. Contrast 要是大家同意，就再确认场地, an if-then step. 不同意就不公布 is compatible with the necessary condition; 同意了还要确认场地 is also compatible. Keep the stated condition and remaining requirements distinct.

examples.zh: 只有大家同意，才公布新安排。
examples.py: zhǐ yǒu dà jiā tóng yì , cái gōng bù xīn ān pái .
examples.en: Only if everyone agrees will the new arrangements be announced.

examples.zh: 只有确认场地，才可以发地址。
examples.py: zhǐ yǒu què rèn chǎng dì , cái kě yǐ fā dì zhǐ .
examples.en: Only after confirming the venue may the address be sent.

examples.zh: 大家同意了，还要等场地批准。
examples.py: dà jiā tóng yì le , hái yào děng chǎng dì pī zhǔn .
examples.en: Everyone has agreed; venue approval is still needed.

commonMistakes.wrong: 只有大家同意才公布，所以同意以后一定立刻公布。
commonMistakes.right: 大家同意以后，还要确认其他要求，再公布。
commonMistakes.why: A necessary condition alone does not guarantee immediate action.

lines.zh: 我有个主意，周五办活动，大家能不能来？
lines.py: wǒ yǒu gè zhǔ yì , zhōu wǔ bàn huó dòng , dà jiā néng bù néng lái ?
lines.en: I have an idea: an event on Friday. Can everyone come?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我认可你的努力，但反对周五这个时间。
lines.py: wǒ rèn kě nǐ de nǔ lì , dàn fǎn duì zhōu wǔ zhè gè shí jiān .
lines.en: I recognize your effort but oppose Friday as the time.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那先了解情况，如何改合适？
lines.py: nà xiān liǎo jiě qíng kuàng , rú hé gǎi hé shì ?
lines.en: Then let us understand the situation; how should we change it?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我主张先问每个人，并且确认场地。
lines.py: wǒ zhǔ zhāng xiān wèn měi gè rén , bìng qiě què rèn chǎng dì .
lines.en: I advocate asking each person and confirming the venue.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 不光要问时间，还要问费用；另外，私人地址别公开。
lines.py: bù guāng yào wèn shí jiān , hái yào wèn fèi yòng ; lìng wài , sī rén dì zhǐ bié gōng kāi .
lines.en: Ask not only the time but the expense; also do not make private addresses public.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，只有大家同意，才公布。现在有人同意了，可以发了吗？
lines.py: hǎo , zhǐ yǒu dà jiā tóng yì , cái gōng bù . xiàn zài yǒu rén tóng yì le , kě yǐ fā le ma ?
lines.en: Okay, announce only if everyone agrees. Some agree now; can we send it?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 还不行，场地还没批准。我坚决不同意先发旧地址。
lines.py: hái bù xíng , chǎng dì hái méi pī zhǔn . wǒ jiān jué bù tóng yì xiān fā jiù dì zhǐ .
lines.en: Not yet; the venue is not approved. I firmly oppose sending an old address first.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先制定清楚的规则，防止大家收到不同版本。
lines.py: xiān zhì dìng qīng chǔ de guī zé , fáng zhǐ dà jiā shōu dào bù tóng bǎn běn .
lines.en: First draw up clear rules to prevent people receiving different versions.
lines.speaker: b

Recognition and complete agreement as the same thing

reading.title: A notice with conditions
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Read the proposed steps without mistaking them for completed actions.

lines.zh: 这个主意还没成为决定，先问能不能参加，了解每个人的情况。
lines.py: zhè gè zhǔ yì hái méi chéng wéi jué dìng , xiān wèn néng bù néng cān jiā , liǎo jiě měi gè rén de qíng kuàng .
lines.en: This idea is not yet a decision; ask whether each person can attend and understand their circumstances.

lines.zh: 有人认可组织者的努力，却反对时间，不能因此说他同意。
lines.py: yǒu rén rèn kě zǔ zhī zhě de nǔ lì , què fǎn duì shí jiān , bù néng yīn cǐ shuō tā tóng yì .
lines.en: Someone recognizes the organizer’s effort but opposes the time; that does not mean consent.

lines.zh: 组织者主张不光问地点，还问费用；并且说明如何报名，以及参加的时间。
lines.py: zǔ zhī zhě zhǔ zhāng bù guāng wèn dì diǎn , hái wèn fèi yòng ; bìng qiě shuō míng rú hé bào míng , yǐ jí cān jiā de shí jiān .
lines.en: The organizer advocates asking not only the venue but the fee, and explaining how to register as well as the time for participating.

lines.zh: 不仅通知要清楚，格式也要符合规范；另外，私人信息不能随便公布。
lines.py: bù jǐn tōng zhī yào qīng chǔ , gé shì yě yào fú hé guī fàn ; lìng wài , sī rén xìn xī bù néng suí biàn gōng bù .
lines.en: The notice must be clear and its format meet the standard; additionally private information cannot be announced casually.

lines.zh: 场地还没批准，要是下雨，就再讨论室内方案。
lines.py: chǎng dì hái méi pī zhǔn , yào shì xià yǔ , jiù zài tǎo lùn shì nèi fāng àn .
lines.en: The venue is unapproved; if it rains, discuss the indoor alternative again.

lines.zh: 只有大家同意，才公布；同意以后还要确认场地许可。
lines.py: zhǐ yǒu dà jiā tóng yì , cái gōng bù ; tóng yì yǐ hòu hái yào què rèn chǎng dì xǔ kě .
lines.en: Announce only if everyone agrees; venue permission still needs confirmation after agreement.

lines.zh: 有人建议制定制度，也要检查入口，预防拥挤，确保大家收到同一通知，不能保证没有危险。
lines.py: yǒu rén jiàn yì zhì dìng zhì dù , yě yào jiǎn chá rù kǒu , yù fáng yōng jǐ , què bǎo dà jiā shōu dào tóng yī tōng zhī , bù néng bǎo zhèng méi yǒu wēi xiǎn .
lines.en: Someone suggests drawing up rules; still check the entrance, prevent crowding and ensure everyone receives the same notice, without guaranteeing an absence of danger.

lines.zh: 由于地址还没核实，因此先不发布；合法与否要看实际规定，不凭一句玩笑判断。
lines.py: yóu yú dì zhǐ hái méi hé shí , yīn cǐ xiān bù fā bù ; hé fǎ yǔ fǒu yào kàn shí jì guī dìng , bù píng yī jù wán xiào pàn duàn .
lines.en: Because the address is unverified, do not publish yet; legality depends on actual rules, not a joke.
